q: The Seifert fibration of a 3-manifold decomposes it into circles. The Euler class of the fibration is an obstruction to:
opts: The existence of a section (global cross-section of the S¹ bundle) — the fibration is trivial iff Euler class = 0
exp: Euler class e(E) ∈ H²(B;ℤ) for an oriented S¹ bundle E → B measures the twisting. A section exists iff e = 0. For the Hopf fibration S³ → S², e is the generator of H²(S²) = ℤ, so no section exists. Seifert fibrations generalise this to orbifold bases.
